summary: Near-zero engagement and reach across all platforms; Instagram reels lose 64% viewers in first 3 seconds (hook failure), zero follower growth despite 23 posts/30 days, LinkedIn inactive for 30 days. Bio violates brand rules: names niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays), region (Himachal), promises '24 hrs' delivery, offers free site check outside website posts.
guidance:
- Hook style: try **question** (1.75x median, n=6) or **myth** (unused recently) for animated ads; rotate away from repeated comparison/contrast.
- Avoid re-phrasing cost/time comparisons (AI vs crew, hours vs minutes) — used in last 3 animated_ads posts.
- Posts must read as a developer showing real work, never as an ad; no demos, samples, or niche targeting.
- Use silhouette or desk-glow image style (1.5x median); consider bold-slow-reveal carousel (2.0x).
- Address 'lack of budget for professional video shoots' problem (top winner) with soft wording: 'can reduce cost', 'helps create'.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 real Indian small-business pain points about video ad costs (e.g., 'spent ₹15k on a shoot, got 10 views') without naming businesses; cite public forums or news.
instructions.analysis: Compare the last 3 animated_ads posts: all use cost/time contrast. Note which hook style (question, comparison, contrast) got any saves/shares; flag repeated phrasing.
instructions.writer: Draft a question-hook post: 'Ever quoted ₹20k for a 15-sec ad and heard "budget nahi hai"?' Explain how AI animation can reduce cost, end with 'pay after approval' and DM invite. No niche, no demo, no guarantees.
instructions.image: Create a silhouette-style graphic: dark background, glowing phone screen showing a looping AI-animated ad frame, subtle code snippet overlay. No logos, no business names.
instructions.video: Skip video today; static image carousel performs better (44% of image earnings) and avoids 64% first-3s drop-off.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: 'AI chatbots, animated ads, lead lists & websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.'
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition or video marketing — no self-promo.
Post one LinkedIn text-only observation about AI ad adoption in Indian SMEs (no service pitch), tag #SmallBusinessIndia #FreelanceIndia.
